text: Have you got your schedule for this term, Monika?
Yes, Yuri, I have. It's going to be quite hard!
Really? What subjects do you take?
I've got Culture Studies, on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 8.30.
Oh, 8.30! That's early. Do you have any classes after that?
Yes. Straight after that at 10 I have a class on Social Change.
That sounds OK. Do you have the afternoon free?
Yes, but only Tuesdays and Thursdays. On Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays I've got Language Development, at two o'clock.
That sounds interesting. What other classes do you have?
I've got Education on Monday morning, at 9.40, and Communication Studies on Wednesdays and Fridays at 10.
Wow. That's a lot of classes.
I know. I hope they'll be good!
